svg.title: Affine host device clock correlation and three different elapsed intervals
svg.desc: Two constructed anchors imply H equals zero point five times device ticks plus one hundred host microseconds. Device ticks one hundred forty through two hundred twenty map to host one hundred seventy through two hundred ten, duration forty microseconds. Host submission lasts two microseconds; submission start to observed completion lasts seventy. Stipulated two microsecond endpoint bounds give interval thirty six to forty four microseconds only under a separately justified calibration window.
svg.text: Host submission is not completed device execution
D: device ticks; H: host μs. Anchors (100,150), (300,250).
Device D = 140 → 220 maps to H = 170 → 210: 40 μs.
Three different boundaries on the host scale
Submission 160 → 162: 2 μs. Mapped device interval: 40 μs.
Assumed endpoint bounds ±2 μs give duration bounds ±4 μs
Mapped interval: [36, 44] μs, only inside the justified fit window.
Two anchors alone do not establish that uncertainty or control drift.
Arithmetic example, not observed calibration or a supplied device API.
